rules.title: Request-directed workflow
rules.normativeText: Planning requests produce planning artifacts. Implementation requests continue through code and the relevant engineering checks.

rules.title: Role QA parity
rules.normativeText: No role is releasable without corresponding QA verification coverage and generated adapter parity.

rules.title: Bounded story decomposition
rules.normativeText: A story produces at most two implementation tasks: frontend and backend when design or UI input exists, otherwise one backend task.

rules.title: Portable capability tiers
rules.normativeText: Roles use registry-owned capability tiers and adapters own host model mapping; vendor model names are not protocol truth.

rules.title: Generated task custody
rules.normativeText: Generated task documents are not manually edited; their reviewed parent source is corrected and deterministic generation is rerun.

rules.title: Immutable Preserve boundaries
rules.normativeText: Every Preserve repository path is immutable for the complete task and SHIP run and is verified against its bound baseline.

rules.title: Adaptive recovery
rules.normativeText: Use command results and diagnostics to choose useful corrections, continue while meaningful engineering progress is possible, and report a genuine impasse with the relevant error context.

rules.title: Proportional verification
rules.normativeText: Local work uses verification proportional to its risk and directly corrects relevant failures. Dedicated release certification owns release closure.

rules.title: Read-only database inspection
rules.normativeText: Database inspection is read-only and cannot issue DDL, DML, or any external mutation.

rules.title: Implementation ownership
rules.normativeText: Frontend and backend ownership boundaries are binding; companion changes must be acceptance-required, disclosed, and outside Preserve.
